content: <thought>All attempts to locate a template using functional‑group and bond criteria returned no results, suggesting the template database does not index this reaction with those filters. The next best approach is to retrieve a broader set of templates (without filters) and then examine each to find one that matches the intramolecular Michael cyclization of a chalcone to a flavanone. Once a suitable template ID is identified, I can retrieve its SMARTS, map the reaction, and return the required mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
